citations.quote: The primary efficacy endpoint was overall response rate (complete response, complete response unconfirmed and partial response) as assessed by International Workshop Criteria (IWC). The key secondary efficacy endpoint was duration of response.

n.text: 115 patients enrolled; 111 treated (safety); 109 evaluable for efficacy

citations.quote: Enrollment of a minimum of 100 evaluable patients was planned; 115 patients were enrolled across 25 study sites in 6 countries. A total of 111 patients who had received at least one dose of pralatrexate were analyzed for safety; and 109 treated patients whose diagnosis of PTCL was confirmed by central pathology review were included in efficacy analysis.

result.text: ORR 27% (n=29; 95% CI 19, 36) in 109 evaluable patients, with CR/CRu 8% (n=9) and PR 18% (n=20); median duration of response 287 days. Responses lasting >=14 weeks occurred in 12% (95% CI 7, 20).

target_moa.text: Folate analogue metabolic inhibitor; structural analogue of methotrexate taken up via the reduced folate carrier (RFC-1) and polyglutamylated by folylpolyglutamyl synthetase (FPGS), with dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) as its main target

citations.quote: Pralatrexate is a structural analogue of the anti-folate drug methotrexate. The applicant claims that, compared to methotrexate, pralatrexate is more effectively taken up by the cancer cells through increased affinity for the 1-
carbon reduced folate carrier (RFC-1) and more efficiently polyglutamylated by folylpolyglutamyl synthetase (FPGS). The main target of pralatrexate is the dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR).
FOLOTYN is a folate analogue metabolic inhibitor indicated for the treatment of patients with relapsed or refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL).
Pralatrexate is a New Molecular Entity (NME) and is structural analogue of the antifolate methotrexate. It contains 2 asymmetric carbon centers at C10 and C19.
